raw_text:
Request to Add Trailing Stop Loss and Trailing Target in Kite App. Hi Zerodha Team,

It would be extremely helpful if Kite could support trailing stop loss and trailing target functionality directly within regular order placement. Currently, users have to manually modify orders, which becomes difficult during fast market movements.

Suggested features:
- Trailing Stop Loss based on points or percentage  
- Trailing Target (profit lock-in as price moves favorably)  
- Ability to set both SL and Target together with trailing option  
- Applicable for intraday as well as delivery orders  
- Optional toggle inside bracket / GTT / regular orders  

This feature would significantly improve risk management and reduce the need for constant monitoring, especially for active traders.

Many modern trading platforms already provide trailing exits, and having this in Kite would make order execution much more efficient.

Please consider adding this in a future update.

 Few year back in 2021 i invest in idcw dividend balance advantage mutual fund at nav 25.8 now it’s 40.6 nav per month dividend is .25 per unit it was regular plan 
 Now I want to switch to direct plan with impacting my monthly dividend which means i need to maintain same unit in direct as it is in regular plan. 
Also I don’t want to give ltgc tax so to get exact 1 lac capital gain 
 If I sell and purchase at same unit in both plan I have given 40k extra from my pocket.and as it is idcw dividend plan it’s nav will not so dynamic that I can recover this loss in future as if it was a growth plan . 
 Friends tell what should do ??

Yes, you can invest in MF by monthly SIP’s (minimum amount is Rs. 500/- per month, you can invest anything higher that Rs. 500/- as per your convenience). 
 Also, one time investment is also there. 
 My suggestion would be to go for monthly SIP’s, because this will take care of market up’s and down’s. When on certain months markets are down, you will higher units, due to smaller per unit rate and vice versa when markets are high.
